title_it: Carmen, Pastelería Sol Valencia (spagnola): Marea 2, allarme livello, sonda incrostata, cartuccia filtro
title_en: Carmen, Pastelería Sol Valencia (Spanish): Marea 2, level alarm, scaled probe, filter cartridge

lines.text: Hello, good afternoon. I am Carmen, from Pasteleria Sol, in Valencia. We have the Marea 2.
lines.cue: Good afternoon, Sereni service, Michael speaking. How can I help you?

lines.text: The machine does not fill with water. The level light is blinking, and the pump is running all the time, it does not stop.
lines.cue: Good afternoon Carmen. What is the problem?

lines.text: The tap is open, yes. The hot water comes out strong, full.
lines.cue: Is the water tap under the counter open? When you open the hot water, does a full flow come out?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Aperto, flusso pieno» → passo scatto elettrovalvola.

lines.text: Yes, I hear a click, click, but it does not fill.
lines.cue: When the machine tries to fill, do you hear the solenoid click at the back?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Scatta ma non carica» → passo sonda di livello.

lines.text: I took it out. The tip is completely white, with scale, like chalk.
lines.cue: Switch the machine off. Unscrew the level probe from the top of the boiler with a 13 spanner, and look at the tip.
lines.expect_it: Resta sul passo sonda (istruzione di pulizia).

lines.text: I cleaned it and put it back. Now the pump stopped, the boiler is full. It works.
lines.cue: Clean the tip with descaler and a cloth, refit it, and switch on.

lines.text: I think the filter is very old. Can you send me a new water filter cartridge? And the serial number is zero five zero, nine zero four.
lines.cue: That scale means hard water. Do you have a filter cartridge on the inlet?
lines.expect_it: Scheda cartuccia ID-4061 dalla descrizione (lo monta il cliente). Scheda macchina 050904: Pastelería Sol, in garanzia, nota «acqua dura, senza addolcitore».

lines.cue: I ship the cartridge from Florence, two to four days, you fit it yourself. Goodbye Carmen.
lines.expect_it: «Chiudi chiamata» → resoconto: remoto + ricambio montato dal cliente.
